newsitem.title: UK: Lanica sees no reason for big share rise.
newsitem.headline: Lanica sees no reason for big share rise.

text.p: Lanica Trust said on Wednesday it was not aware of any reasons for the substantial increase in its share price over recent months.
Lanica's shares have soared, closing at 15.50 stg on Wednesday, down 1.25 stg but far above the 2.03 stg per share paid by entrepeneur Andrew Regan when he took control late last year.

Last week, privately-owned British retail and gambling group Littlewoods ruled out any use of the company as a vehicle for listing the group or part of it after rumours had been credited with sweeping Lanica shares higher.
Lanica changed its name from New Guernsey Securities when Regan took over.
"Lanica has managed and will continue to manage its investment portfolio...in accordance with the investment policy set out in the offer document for the company," a statement from the company said.
